package.description: A desktop SQL IDE for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, and JDBC/ODBC databases.

en-US.description: A desktop SQL IDE for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, and JDBC/ODBC databases.
en-US.name: omni-sql
en-US.releaseNotes:
omni-sql v0.23.2
- Fix: running a selection that contains several statements separated by ; now runs each statement in order instead of sending the whole selection as one command. Selecting multiple UPDATEs and pressing Run works on databases that accept one statement per call, such as Oracle.
This replaces v0.23.1, whose release build failed before publishing (the Windows portable package could not be created after a Rust toolchain update).
Full Changelog: v0.23.0...v0.23.2
